stepHints.basics: Name, category, content type and the cover shown in the campaign list.
stepHints.brief: Write the brief yourself, or pick Team-assisted and our team will put it together.
stepHints.platforms: Pick the platforms clippers post on, then set the rate per 1,000 views.
stepHints.rewards: One campaign can pay several rewards at once. Each reward has its own pool.
stepHints.budget: Set each pool's budget and the per-clip cap. Once a pool runs out, its rules stop paying.
stepHints.eligibility: Decide who can take this campaign.
stepHints.schedule: When the campaign starts, when submissions close and who reviews clips.

save.partial: Saved — rewards & budget are left out until they're complete
save.error: Couldn't save. See the message below.
save.invalid: Can't save yet — some fields need fixing
save.needTitle: Add a campaign name (3+ characters) so the draft can be saved
save.invalidToast: The draft can't be saved yet. Fix the fields marked in red first.

guard.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page anyway?

banner.lockedTitle: Campaign submitted — the brief is locked
banner.lockedBody: Clippers who took the campaign are judged against the same brief, so it can't change anymore. You can still add FAQ entries.
banner.rejectedTitle: Campaign rejected by the review team
banner.rejectedBody: Fix it based on the team's notes, then submit again. Once saved, it goes back to draft.
banner.unverifiedBody: You can still build and save drafts. Submit unlocks once our team verifies your organization.
banner.suspendedBody: Campaigns can't be saved or submitted for now. Contact the Clipper team for details.
banner.templateBody: Templates can be edited and saved but not submitted. Duplicate it into a new campaign to submit.
banner.managedAdminBody: The brand asked our team to compose this campaign. The raw brief and internal files are in the side panel. When you're done, press Send to brand.

typeHints.clipping: Clippers cut your videos into short clips.
typeHints.ugc: Clippers make original content about your product.
typeHints.music: Clippers use your song or sound in their videos.
typeHints.logo: Clippers show your logo or watermark in the video.
typeHints.text: Clippers show a specific text or caption in the video.

basics.title: Campaign name
basics.titleHelper: 3–120 characters. Shown in the campaign list.
basics.slugHelper: Lowercase letters, numbers and -, 3–80 characters. Leave it empty to generate it from the name.
basics.coverHelper: Shown on the campaign card and link previews. 16:9 works best.
basics.coverLimits: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB.

brief.modeSelfHint: Write the brief, rules and assets right here.
brief.modeManagedHint: Send a raw brief + files and our team builds the campaign. You just approve and pay.
brief.managedSectionHint: Describe the campaign you want. Files here are visible only to your org members and the Clipper team, never to clippers.
brief.rawBriefHelper: Campaign goal, target audience, content style, and must-haves / don'ts.
brief.internalFilesHelper: Video, image, audio or PDF, up to 500 MB per file.
brief.structuredOptionalHint: You can leave this empty — our team fills it in. If you already know the rules, add them here.
brief.textHelper: Markdown works: **bold**, *italic*, lists with -, and https links. HTML is not rendered.
brief.previewNote: This is how the brief looks in the clipper app.
brief.examplesHelper: Links to example videos. https:// is added when missing.
brief.requiredSectionHint: Checked automatically on submit. Captions missing any of these are rejected.
brief.hashtagsHelper: Letters, numbers and _. Stored lowercase without #.
brief.linksHelper: Must be https. https:// is added when missing.
brief.durationHelper: Leave empty for any length. Clips outside this range are rejected.
brief.sponsoredHint: Clippers must turn on the platform's paid partnership / sponsored label.
brief.faqLockedHint: The brief is locked, but you can keep adding FAQ entries.
brief.assetsHelper: Raw footage, logos, sounds or PDF guides. Upload a file (up to 500 MB) or paste a link.
brief.assetLinkHelper: e.g. a Google Drive folder. Must be https.

platforms.disabled: This platform is switched off; its views can't be tracked yet.
platforms.rateIntro: Paid in {reward} ({unit}) from the main reward.
platforms.rateIntroNoPool: Add a reward first in Rewards & rules.
platforms.noPoolsBody: Pick what you pay in (e.g. Rupiah) first, then set the rate.
platforms.noneBody: This campaign doesn't pay per views yet. That suits UGC paid per post — set it up in Rewards & rules.
platforms.customTitle: Rates are set in Rewards & rules
platforms.customBody: Your rate setup goes beyond one rate per platform, so edit it in Rewards & rules.
platforms.moreRules: Want to pay per post, milestone bonuses, tiered rates or other rewards (e.g. Diamonds)? Set them up in the next step.

rewards.noRules: No rules yet. A reward without rules never pays out.
rewards.addTierHint: Fill in To on the last tier first.
rewards.addPoolHint: e.g. Rupiah + Diamonds: each reward has its own budget and runs out on its own.
rewards.allTypesUsed: All reward types are in use.

kindHints.milestone_bonus: One-time bonus when a clip reaches a view count.
kindHints.tiered_cpm: Different rates per view range, e.g. 0–50K Rp2,000, above that Rp1,500.

budget.poolTotalHelper: The total you'll pay clippers from this reward.
budget.maxPerClipHelper: Earning cap for one clip from this reward.
budget.estNote: Estimated paid views until the budget runs out (budget ÷ rate × 1,000).
budget.estNone: The views estimate appears once the budget and a per-views rate are set.
budget.limitsHint: The defaults fit most campaigns. Change them if needed.
budget.minViewsHelper: Once reached, every view counts. Default 1,000.
budget.quotaHelper: How many different clippers can take the campaign. Leave empty for no limit.
budget.reuse: Accept videos already submitted to another campaign
budget.reuseHint: When off, videos already used in another campaign are rejected.

eligibility.minFollowersHelper: Checked against the clipper's connected account.
eligibility.accountAgeHelper: Newer accounts can't take the campaign.
eligibility.kycHint: Only clippers with a verified identity can take it.
eligibility.visibilityHint: Private campaigns don't appear in the public list.
eligibility.inviteTitle: Invite clippers once the campaign is approved
eligibility.inviteBody: Invite-only campaigns are visible only to clippers you invite by username.

visibilityHints.invite: Only clippers you invite can see and take it.
visibilityHints.level: Only clippers with the min Trust Score set above.

schedule.startHelper: WIB time. Goes live after review and payment.
schedule.deadlineHelper: WIB time. Clippers can't submit after this.
schedule.viewWindowHelper: From posting, 1–90 days. Default 30 days or until the campaign ends.
schedule.reviewModeHint: Who approves clips before views start counting.

reviewHints.manual: Our moderators check every clip. The safest option.
reviewHints.brand: You review in the Review menu. Clips not reviewed within 72 hours are auto-approved.
reviewHints.auto: Clips that pass the automatic checks (hashtags, duration) are tracked right away.

summary.issuesTitle: A few things still need attention
summary.totalNote: 100% of the creator budget goes to clippers. The invoice is issued when you submit; content review runs alongside payment.
summary.totalNoteManaged: The team-assisted package is billed on a separate invoice. 100% of the creator budget goes to clippers.
summary.unknownRewardType: Some rewards have no known Rupiah value, so they aren't counted yet.
summary.feeOverrideHint: Per-campaign fee override. Saved with the draft.
summary.submitHint: Once submitted, the invoice is issued and the brief is locked (FAQ can still be added).
summary.managedWaitHint: You chose Team-assisted: wait for our notification that the draft is ready before submitting. The package is billed separately.
summary.sendHint: The brand gets notified to check the summary, then submits and pays. The team-assisted invoice is issued once.
summary.submitBody: An invoice of {total} will be issued and the brief locks right away. Only FAQ can be added after that.
summary.sendTitle: Send the draft to the brand?
summary.sendBody: The brand is told the draft is ready to approve. It stays editable until the brand submits.
summary.submitted: Campaign submitted! Check the invoice under Billing.
summary.notReady: Some things still need fixing before you can submit.
summary.unverified: Your organization isn't verified yet. You can submit once it's verified.
summary.template: Templates can't be submitted. Duplicate it into a campaign first.
summary.nonCashLine: Non-cash reward value (brand stock, fee base — not billed)

upload.needSave: Add a campaign name first — the draft must be saved before uploading.

errors.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers and -, 3–80 characters.
errors.hashtag: Hashtags can only use letters, numbers and _ (no spaces).
errors.mention: Mentions can only use letters, numbers, _ and dots.
errors.durationPositive: Duration must be more than 0 seconds.
errors.durationRange: Max duration must be ≥ min duration.
errors.assetSource: An asset must be either a file or a link.
errors.assetFolder: This file is in the wrong folder. Remove it and upload again.
errors.levelNeedsTrust: By-level visibility needs a min Trust Score above 0.
errors.scheduleOrder: The deadline must be after the start.
errors.deadlinePast: The deadline has passed. Pick a future time.
errors.poolNeedsRule: Each reward needs at least one payout rule.
errors.ruleThreshold: View count must be more than 0.
errors.tierTo: The upper bound must be above the lower bound.
errors.tierOpenLast: Set an upper bound — only the last tier can be open-ended.
errors.tierGap: Each tier must start where the previous one ends.
errors.rulePlatform: This platform isn't selected in Platforms & rates.
errors.rulePool: The rule must point to a reward in this campaign.
errors.templateSubmit: Templates can't be submitted. Duplicate it into a campaign first.

server.generic: Something went wrong while saving. Please try again.
server.network: Connection problem. Check your internet and try again.
server.payload: Invalid campaign data. Reload the page and try again.
server.orgId: A campaign can't move to another organization.
server.slugTaken: This link is taken by another campaign. Try another one.
server.list: A list contains an invalid entry.
server.assetPath: An asset file is invalid. Remove it and upload again.
server.pool: Each reward's budget and max per clip must be more than 0.
server.poolId: A reward no longer exists. Reload the page.
server.poolInUse: A rule still uses this reward. Remove the rule first.
server.rewardType: Your org can't use this reward type.
server.ruleParams: A rule has an invalid amount.
server.ruleRewardType: The rule's reward doesn't match its pool.
server.schedule: Set the start time and the submission deadline.
server.locked: The campaign was submitted, so only the FAQ can change.
server.orgNotVerified: Your organization isn't verified yet, so you can't submit.
server.poolsLocked: The budget is already paid. Add budget with a top-up from the campaign dashboard.
server.feeRuleMissing: Fee configuration is missing. Contact the Clipper team.
server.forbidden: You don't have access to edit this campaign.
server.noSession: Your session expired. Please log in again.
server.invalidField: The server rejected a field. Please check it.
server.category: This category is no longer available.
